text: Moa in 991 krèg Ethelred te moake bij ne Vikingvloot groeder dan wa ein oek van Guthrum honderd joar doa voèrre.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Dèie boate wàrre aengevoèrd door Olaf Trygvasson, iene uìt Noorweìge diè zij land woù herpakke op de Dène hunne bezetting.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Noà ijoste militère tègenslieg was t Ethelred gelùkt vrieie te sloàte bei Olaf, diè noà Noorwége terugkoèm om sei reìk te heroèvere, ma da lukte nie helegans.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangul is ‘t einegste doelbewus oetgevoonde alfabet in populair daogeleks gebruuk. ‘t Alfabet woort oetgevonde in 1444 tijens ‘t bewind vaan keuning Sejong (1418-1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Keuning Sejong waor de veerde keuning vaan de Joseon-dynastie en is ein vaan de mies gewaardeerde.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Heer neumde ‘t Hangeul-alfabet Oorspreunkelek Hunmin Jeongeum, wat “de riechtege geluide veur de instructie vaan de lui” beteikent.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Dao zien väöl theorieën euver wie ‘t Sanskriet is oontstoon. Eine daorvaan geit euver ‘n Arische migratie oet ‘t weste nao India die hun taol mèt ziech mètbrach.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskriet is ‘n aw taol en is vergeliekbaar mèt de Latiense taol die in Europa weurt gesproke.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: ‘t Vreugste bekènde book ter eerd is in ‘t Sanskriet gesjreve. Nao de compilatie vaan Upanishads goenk ‘t Sanskriet voèt deùr boàze.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskriet is n zier complexe en rieke taol, die de bron is gewees veur väöl modern Indiase taole, sjus zoe wie ‘t Latien de bron is veur Europese taole zoe wie Frans en Spaons.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Toen de strijd um Fraankriek veurbij waor, begós Duitsland ziech klaor te mae um ‘t eiland Groet-Brittanië binne te valle.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Duitsland gaof de aonval de codenaom “Operatie Zieliew”. De mieste zwoere waopes en veuurapde vaan ‘t Britse leger waore verlore gegaange toen ‘t oet Duinkerke geëvacueerd woort, dus waor ‘t leger vrij zwaak.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Mer de Koninkleke Marine waor nog steeds väöl sterker daan de Duitse Marine (“Kriegsmarine”) en had eder invasievloot die euver ‘t Eengelse Kanaal waor gesjik, kinne vernetige.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Dao woorte evels mer hiel wienig Royal Navy-sjepe gestationeerd in de buurt vaan de waarsjijnleke invasieroutes, umdat de admiraols bang waore dat ze door ‘n Duitse lochaonval tot zinke zouwe weure gebrach.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Laot ever beginne mèt ‘n oetlègk euver de planne vaan Italië, Italië waor veural ‘t “kleine breurke” vaan Duitsland en Japan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: ‘t Had ‘n zwaaker leger en n zwaaker marine, allewijl ze zjus veur ‘t begin vaan de oorlog veer nuie sjepe hadde gebouwd.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: De belaankriekste doele vaan Italië waore Afrikaanse lande. Um die lande te verovere zouwe ze ‘n lanceerplatform veur troepe nudeg höbbe, zoedat troepe euver de Middelandse Zie kinne zeile en Afrika kinne binnevalle.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Daoveur móste zie ziech oontdoen vaan Britse basis en sjepe in Egypte. Neve deze acties mochte de Italiaonse slaagsjepe niks aanders doen.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Noe veur Japan. Japan waor ‘n eiland, zjus wie Groet-Brittanië.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Oonderziejers zien sjepe die zien oontworpe um onder water te reize en daor veur ‘n langere tied te blieve.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Oonderziejers woorte gebruuk in de Ierste en Twiede Wereldoorlog. Destiets waore ze erg traag en hadde ze ‘n zier beperk sjeetbereik.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: In ‘t begin vaan de oorlog reisde ze miestal p d etop vaan de zie, mer toen de radar ziech begós te ontwikkele en nauwkeureger woort, woorte de oonderziejers gedwonge onder water te goon um neet gezeen te weure.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Duitse oonderziejers woorte U-boten geneump. De Duitsers waore erg good in ‘t navigere en bedeene vaan hun oonderziejers.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Vaanwege hun succes mèt oonderziejers, weurt nao de oorlog neet dao op vertreùt da de Preùsse dao väöl vaan höbbe.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Jao! Keuning Toetanchamon, ouch wel “King Tut” of “The Boy King” geneump is ein vaan de mies bekènde awwe Egyptische keuninge in de moderne tied.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Interessant is dat heer in de aajdheid neet es erg belaankriek woort besjouwd en neet op de mieste awwe keuningslieste stoont.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: De oontdèkking vaan zien graaf in 1922 maakte häöm eder ‘n bereumpheid, Allerwijl väöl grave oet ‘t verleie woorte beroof, woort dit graaf vrijwel oongesteurd gelaote.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: De mieste veurwerpe die mèt Toatanchamon zien begraove, zien good bewaord gebleve, boe-onder doezende veurwerpe gemaak vaan edel metaole en zeldzaam stein.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: De oetvinding vaan spaakwiele maaktde Assyrische strijdwages liechter, sneller en beter veurbereid um soldaote en aander strijdwages te oontlaoupe.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Pijle vana hun duujelek kruusbaoge kóste ‘t pantser vaan rivaliserende soldaote binnedringe. Roond 1000 veur Christus introduceerde de Assysriërs de ierste cavalerie.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: ‘n cavalarie is ‘n lièger da te peerde böttelt. ‘t Zadel waor nog neet oetgevonde, dus böttelde de Assyrische cavalarie op de bloete rögk vaan hun peerd.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Veer kinnd väöl Griekse politici, wetensjappers en kunsteneers. Missjien wel de mies bekènde persoen vaan dees cultuur is Homerus, de legendarische blinne diechter, dee twie meisterwerke oet de Griekste literatuur componeerde: de gediechte Ilias en Odyssee.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles en Aristophanes zien nog ummertouw populaire toneelsjrievers en hun toneelstökke woorte besjouwd es ein vaan de groetste werke vaan de wereldliteratuur.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: ‘n Aander bereumpde Griek is de wiskundige Pythagoras, veural bekènd um zien bereumpde stèlling euver de relaties vaan de kante vaan rechhokege dreihook.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Dao zien versjèllende sjatiinge veur wieväöl lui Hindi spreke. ‘t Weurt gesjat op de twiede tot de veerde mies gesproke taol ter wièrelt.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: ‘t Aontal moojerstaolsprekers hingk aof vaan ‘t al dan neet telle vaa nzier nauw verwante dialecte.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Sjattinge loupoe oetein vaan 340 mieljoen ott 500 mieljoen sprekers, en mer leefs 800 mieljoen lui kinne de taol begriepe.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi en Urdu zien vergeliekbaar in woordesjat, mer versjèllend in scrip; in alledagse gesprekke kinne sprekers vaan allebei de taole ziech miestal verstoon.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Rond de 15e iew stoond ‘t noorde vaan Estland oonder groete culturele invloed vaan Duitsland.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Sommege Duitse mónnike wèlde God diechter beì de lokàle miènse breenge, dus voonte zie de Estse schreiftaol oet.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: ‘t waor gebaseerd op ‘t Duitse alfabet en éín teike “Õ/õ”woord touwgevoog.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Naomate de tied verstreek, kaome väöl wäörd die oet ‘t Duits waore geliend same. Dit waor ‘t begin vaan verliechting.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Traditioneìl góng de erfgenaom vaan de troen direk nao ‘t beëindege vaan de sjaol ‘t lièger in.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Charles ging evels nao de universiteit aon ‘t Trinity College in Camrbidge, boe heer antropologie en acheologie studeerde, en later gesjiedenis, en behaolde ‘n 2:2 (‘n lieger twiedeklas graod).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles waor ‘t ierste lid vaan de Britse Keuninkleke femielie dat ‘n diploom kraog.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Europees Turkijke (oostelek Thracië of Roemelië op ‘t Balkansjiereiland) umvat 3% vaan’t land.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: ‘t Groondgebeed vaan Turkije is mie es 1600 kilometer (1000 mijl) laank en 800 km (500 mijl) breid, mèt groofweg ‘n rechhokige vörm.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: ‘t Gebeed vaan Turkije, inclusief mere, besleir 783.562 veerkante kilometer (300.948 veerkante mijl) boevaan 755.688 veerkante kilometers (291.773 veerkante mijl) in Zuidwes-Azië e 23.764 veerkante kilometers (9174 veerkante mijl) in Europa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: ‘t Gebeed vaan Turkijke maak ‘t ‘t 37e groetste land ter wereld en ‘t is umtrint zoe groet es metropool Fraankriek en ‘t Vereineg Keuningkriek same.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkije weurt aon drei kante umringk door zieje De Egeïsche zie in ‘t weste, de Zwarte Zie in t noorde en de Middelandse zie in t zuie.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxemburg heet ‘n lang gesjiedenis, mer de oonaofhaankelekheid dateert vaan 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: De huidege deile vaan Belsj maakde in ‘t verleie deil oet vaan Luxemburg, meir woorte nao de Belsje revolutie vaan 1830 Belsj.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburg heet altied geperbeerd ‘n neutraal land te blieve, mer ‘t woort zoewel in de ierste es in de twiede wereldoorlog bezat door Duitsland.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: In 1957 woort Luxemburg ein vaan de opriechters vaan de organisatie die tegewoordeg bekènd steit es de Europese Unie.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: De Drukgyzal Dzong is ‘n verweus fort en e boeddhistisch kloester in ‘t bovenste deil vaan ‘t Paro-distrik (in t dörp Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Dao weurt gezag dat Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel in 1649 ‘t fort heet gebiouwd um zien euverwinninge op de Tibetaanse-Mongoolse strijdkrachte te herdinke.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: In 1951 zörgde ‘n brand daoveur dat mer e paar vaan de rillekwieë vaan de Drukgyal Dzong euverbleve, zoees ‘t beeld vaan Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Nao de brand woort t fort bewaort en besjermp en bleef ‘t ein vaan de mies sensationele attracties vaan Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Tijdens de 18e iew bevond Cambodja ziech tusse twie mechtege bure, Thailand en Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: De Thais vele in de 18e iew versjèllende kiere Cambodja binne en vernetege in 1772 Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: In de lètste jaore vaan de 18e iew vele de Vietnameze ouch Cambodja binne.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Achttien percent vaan de Venezolanen is werkloos en de mieste lui wèrke in de informele economie.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Twie derde vaan de Venezolanen die wèrke, deit dat in de deenssector, bijnao ‘n kwaart wèrk in de industrie en ‘n vijfde in de landbouw.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: E belaangriek industrie veur Venezolanen is olie, boe ‘t land ‘n netto-exporteur is, allewijl mer èìn percent in de olie-industrie wèrk.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Vreug in de oonaofhaankelekheid vaan ‘t land heelp de expertise vaan Singapore Botanic Gardens um ‘t eiland um te vörme tot ‘n tropische tuinstad.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: In 1981 woort Vanda Miss Joaquim, ‘n orchidee-hybride, gekoze es de nationaole blom vaan ‘t land.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Eder jaor reize umtrint oktober bijnao 1,5 mieljoen herbivore nao de zuieleke vlaakdes, die de Mara-rivier euversteke, vaanoet de noordeleke heuvels veur de rege.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: En daan trök nao ‘t noorde door t weste, obbenuits de Mara-rivier euversteke, nao de reges roond april.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: De serengeti-regio bevat ‘t Serengeti National Park, ‘t Ngorongoro Conservation Area en Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania en ‘t Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenia.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: ‘t Liere make vaan interactieve media vereis conventioneel en traditioneel veerdegheid en ouch tools die oonder de knee zien in interactieve lèsse (storyboard, audio- en videobewerking, verhaole vertèlle, enz.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: ‘t Interactief oontwerp vereis dat ger uuch aonnames euver mediaproductie obbenuits beoordeilt en op neet-lineaire menere liert dinke.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Interactief oontwerpe vereis dat oonderdeil vaan ‘n project op ein aonslete, mer ouch es ‘n aofzoonderlek gehiel zinvol zien.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: ‘t Naodeil vaan zoomlenze is dat de branpuntscomplexiteit en ‘t aontal lenseleminte dat nudeg is um ‘n reeks brandpuntsaofstande te bereike väöl groeter is daan bij primelenze.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Dit weurt minder ‘n perbleem naomate lensfabrikante hoegere norme haole bij de productie vaan lenze.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: heidoor kóste zoomlenze beelde producere vaan ‘n kwaliteit die vergeliekbaar is mèt die vaan lenze mèt ‘n vas brandpuntsaofstand.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: ‘n Aander naodeil vaan zoomlenze is da ‘t maximoùl diafragma (snelheid) vaan de lens miestal lieger is.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Dit maak beterkoupe zoomlenze meujelek te gebruke bij wieneg leech zoonder flitser.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Eìn van de meist veurkòmende probleìme bei t euverzètte van ne film noà DVD is de euverscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: De mètste tielevizes zijn gemoakt om veùl mense e plezier te doàn.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Daarvoar is alles wat djie zièt op de televise voèt gesneè, boeve, onner en lèngszeie.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Dit wordt gedaan om ervoor te zorgen dat het beeld het hele scherm beslaat. Dat wordt overscan genoemd.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Spètig, as dzjie ne DVD moakt, zullen de raèn denk ich oek kotter woère, en as de onnertitels te kot bij de onnerkant van de video zoaten, zullen ze nie helegans jonnen getoand.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Eùver t traditioneìl kastèl uìt de Middelieuwe is lank gefantasièrd en mense dènke dan oan beìlde van gevèchte, fèste en ridders weì bei Arthur.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Zelfs te midde van doezend jaor aè ruïnes is het gemekelek om aon t geluid en de geùr van lang geleie veldslièg te denke, om bekans t geklètter van hoeèn op de keì te heure dei uìt de pùt van de kèirkers omhuìg kòmt.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Mà is osse fantasie gebasierd op de realiteit? Veurwa ijonde kasteìle in de ijoste plak geboùwd? Wei warre ze geboùwd en ontweurpe?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Typisch veur de periode, Kirby Muxloe Castle is mie ‘n versterk hoes daan ‘n ech kestiel.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Dr groete glaze roete en dunne moere zouwe ‘n vasteberaoje aonval neet lang höbbe kinne weerstoon.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: In de jaore 1480, toen Lord Hastings mèt de bouw begós, waor ‘t land in relatief vrei en waor verdediging allein nudeg tege kleine grópe roondzwervende plundereers.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: ‘t Machsevewiech waor ‘n systeem boe-in Europese naties perbeerde de nationaole soevereiniteit vaan alle Europese staote te behouwe.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: ‘t Concep waor dat alle Europese naties móste perbere te veurkoume dat éín natie mechteg zouw weure, en daorum veranderde nationaole regeringe dèks hun allianties um ‘t evewiech te bewaoore.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: De Spaonse Successieoorlog markierde de ierste oorlog boevaan ‘t beloàngrekste ‘t machsevewiech waor.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Dit beteikende ‘n belaankrieke verandering, aongezeen Europese staote neet langer ‘t veurwendsel zouwe höbbe um relizjieuze oorloge te zien. De dertigjaorege oorlog zouw dus de lèste oorlog zien dee es ‘n relizjeus oorlog woort bestempeld.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: De tempel vaan Artemis in Efeze woort op 21 juli 356 veur Christus verweus door e brandstiechting door Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: De reis nao Disney world is ‘ne groete bedevaart veur väöl Amerikaanse femilies.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: e typisch bezeuk besteit oet e vlöch nao Orlando International Airport, e bösrit nao ‘n hotel neve ‘t park, ‘n ganse week zoonder ‘t terrein te verlaote en weer trögk nao hoes gaon.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Dao zien ooneindeg väöl variëoùses meugelek, meh dit blijf wat lui miestal bedoel es ‘t euver “e bezeuk aon Disneyland” höbbe.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Väöl keerte wa online verkoch weure door veilink websites zoe-es eBay of Craigslist, zien gedeiltelek gebruukte mierdaagse park-hopper keerte
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Al is dit e gans gebrukelek activiteit, ‘t is verbooje door Disney: de tickets kinne neet doorverkoch weure.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Wie in de Grand Canyon oonder de rand wil kamperen, mot hijveur ’n vergunning veur ’t achterland höbbe.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Om de Grand Canyon te besjerme, waere d’r maar ’n beperkt aantal vergunninge oetgegaeve. Deze zeen besjikbaar op de 1ste vaan de maond, veer maond veur de ingangsmaond.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Vergunninge veur ’t achterland veur startdatums in mei zeen daorum besjikbaar vanaaf 1 januari.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: De meist populaire gebede, wie de Bright Angel Campground naeve de Phantom Ranch, zeen meistal nao de ierste daag dat se aope zeen veur reserveringen al vol.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Vergunninge ter plaatse waere beperkt aafgegaeve, op basis van “wie ’t ierst kump, wie ’t ierst maalt”.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Zuid Afrika met de oto binne gaon is e fantasitisch mener um de ganse sjoenegheid vaan de regio te zien en ouch um op plaotse te koume boe de normoàl toeriste routes neet koume.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Dit kinste doen mèt ‘ne normale oto este good plans, meh ‘ne 4x4 weurd toch wel geadviseerd en väöl locaties zien allein te berieke mèt de hoege weegligking vaan ‘ne 4x4.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Al is Zuid afrika e stabiel land, dink d’r aon dat neet alle naoberlande dat ouch zien.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Visa benudeghede en koste variëre vaan land tot land en weure beïnvlood dor ‘t land boe datste vendaon kumps.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: eder land heet ouch unieke wette euver welke noedveurzieninge de in dien eige oto mós höbbe.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls is e stedje in ‘t westelek deil vaan Zimbabwe, euver de sjraom mèt Livingstone, Zambia en kortbij Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: ‘t Stedje ligk metein neve de watervalle, en ze zien ‘ne groete attractie, meh dees poulair toeriste bestumming beujt avonturiers en toeriste väöl meugelekhede veur e langer verblief.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: in ‘t regesezoen (november tot miert), zal ‘t watervolume groeter zien en zien de watervalle dramatischer.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: De weurs zowiezoe naat este euver d’n brögk of op de paajer in de buurt vaan de watervalle luip.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Meh percijs umtot ‘t watervolume zoe groet is, is dien ziech op de eigeleke watervalle hiel slech door al ‘t opspattend water.
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: De Tombe vaan Toetankamun (KV62). KV62 zouw de bereumpste tombe vaan de vallei kinne zien, de buun vaan Howard Carters oontdèkking in 1922 vaan de bekans intacte royale begraffenis vaan d’n jonge keunink.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Vergelieke mèt de meiste aander keuninkleke tombes is de tombe vaan Tutankhamun emperkes de meujte umtot ‘r väöl kleiner is mèt erg wieneg decartaties.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Ederein die geinteresseert is in ‘t bewies vaan sjaoi aon de mummie, oontstoon tijdens poginge um ‘m te verwijdere oet de kis, zal teleurgestelt zien want allein ‘t hoof en de sjouwers zien ziechbaar.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: De fantastische riekdom vaan de tombe zien neet mie dao, meh zien euvergebrach noa ‘t Egymptisch Museum in Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: bezeukers met wieneg tied kinne ‘t bèste öreges aanders hun tied spendere.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km zuid-ooste vaan Siem Reap. Dees heuveltop tempel waor gebouwd op ‘t einde vaan de 9de iew tijdens de regeerperiode vaan keunink Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: De soomber atmosfeer in de tempel en ‘t oetziech euver ‘t Tonle Sap meer make de klum de meujte weerd.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: e bezeuk vaan de ‘t gebeed kin gemekelek gecombineert weure mèt e boottoch nao ‘t meer.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: De Angkor Pass is nudeg um de tempel binne te trejje dus vergèt neet um dien paspoort mè te numme este nao Tonle Sap geis.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem is de hoofstad en de groetste stad vaan Israel, meh de mieste len en de VS erkenne ‘t neet es de hoofstad vaan Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: De iewe-aw stad in de heuvels vaan Judea heet ‘n facinerende gesjiedenis wat ziech euver doezende jaore aofspäölde.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: De stad is heileg veur drei monotheïstische godsdeenste - jodedom, christedom en islam en is e spiritueel, religieus en cultureel centrum.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Vaanwege de relisgieuze significantie vaan de stad en bezunders de väöl aw plekke in de binnestad, is Jerusalem ein vaan de belaankriekste toeristische bestumminge in Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem heet väöl historische, archeologische en culturele plaotse same mèt levedege en drökke winkelcentra, kaffees en restaurants.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador wèlt dat Cubane iers ‘n invitatie breef kriege veurdat ze Ecuador ingoon door internationaole vleegvelde of aander sjraomposte.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Dees breef moot oonderteikend zien door ‘t ministerie vaan boetelandse zake vaan Ecuador en moot ouch aon bepaolde eise voldoen.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Dees eise zien oontworpe um de migratie tösse de len te organisere.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Cubaanse börgers die ‘n Amerikaans verblijfsvergönning höbbe, mote ‘t Ecuadoriaanse consulaat bezeuke um ‘n oetzundering vaan dees eis te kriege.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Eur paspoort mot mie es 6 maand geldig zien nao eure reisdata. E retourticket is nudeg um d’n tied vaan t verblief te bewieze.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Tours zien gooikouper veur groetere Gróppe, dus es te allein bis of mèt sjus ein vrund, perbeer aander lui te ontmoete en ‘ne gróp te make vaan veer tot zés veur ‘ne betere pries per persoen.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Meh, dit zou uuch geine zörge mótte make, want dèks weure toeriste gewisseld um de wagele te völle.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: ‘t Liekt mie ‘n meneer um de luij te fótsje zoe dat ze dinke dat ze mie móste betaole.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Oetstekend bove de noorder zije vaan Machu Picchu is dìze steile berg, dèks d’n achtergroond vaan väöl foto’s.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: ‘t Zuut ontmoedegent oet van oonder, en is ouch ‘ne stijle en lestege klum, meh de mieste redelek fitte persoene zouwe in staot mote zien um ‘t in ongeveer 45 minuten te redde.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: kingerköpkes zien euver ‘t groetste deil vaan ‘t pad gelag, en in de steiler stökke beeje staol kabels ‘n steunend handvat.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: dat gezag höbbend, verwach boete aosem te zien, en zeet veurziechteg op de steiler stökke, veural es ‘t naat is, umtot ‘t gaw erreg gevaarlek kin weure.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: De höbs e klein grötje kortbij d’n top boe-door geer moot gaon, ‘t is bès lieg en nogal krap.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: ‘t Bekieke vaan plekke en natuur vaan de Galapagos kinste ‘t beste doen mèt ‘ne boot, sjus wie Darwin ‘t ouch heet gedaon in 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Mier es 60 cruise sjepe ploge de watere vaan de Galapagos - versjelend in groete vaan 8 tot 100 passageers.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: De mieste lui boke hunne plaots good op tied (umtot de beut miestal vol zien in ‘t hoegsesoen).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Zeet zeker tot de mins dee uuch de reis verkoup ‘n Galapagos expert is mèt gooje kinnes euver väöl sjepe.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Demèt kaveert geer tot uur speciaol intresse en/of beperkinge gematcht weure mèt ‘t sjip wat ‘t mies gesjik is.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Ie de Spanjaarde arreveerde in de 16de iew, waor noord Chile bestuurd door de Inca’s, wijl de oersprunkeleke Araucaniërs in centraol en zui Chili woende.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: De Mapuche waore ouch ein vaan de lèste oonaofhenkeleke oersprunkeleke gròppe, wat neet gans opgenome waore in de Spaons sprekende euverhiersing tot Chile’s independentie.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Nochtans Chile de independentie oetroop in 1810 (oonderwijl de Napoleontische oorloge, wat Spaanje veur e paar jaore zoonder centraol functionerende euverheid leet), waor ‘n behöbbeleke euverwinning op Spaanje neet behaold tot 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: De Dominicaanse Republiek (Spaans: República Dominicana) is ’n Caribisch land in ’t ooste vaan ‘t eiland Hispaniola, boe aug Haïti lik.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: ‘t Land heet neet allein witte zandstranden en gebergtes, maar aug de ouwste Europese stad in ’t Amerikaanse continent. Tegenwoordig maakt deze stad deil oet van Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: De Taíno en de Cariben waore de ierste inwoners vaan ‘t eiland. De Cariben kalde ’n Arawak-taol, en waore rond 10.000 jaor veur de jaortelling aangekomme.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Binnen ‘n paar jaor naodat de Europese ontdekkingsreizigers zeen aangekomme, hadde de Spaanse vereuveraers ’n groot deil van de Taino weggevaag.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Volgens Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) höbbe de Spaanse vereuveraers tösse 1492 en 1498 zo’n 100.000 Taíno vermaord.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Unión. Dees ruimte waor gebouwd es hoof veur ‘t 17de iewse kloester boe-vaan de Templo de San Diego ‘t einsegste euverlevende bouw is.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: ‘t Functioneert noe es centraol plein, en heet altied väöl te beeje, daag en nach.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Dao zien e poàr restaurants roontelum d’n hoof, en in de middeg en de aovende weure dao dèks gratis concèrs gegeve vaanoet de meziekkioske.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (‘t puungetske). Twie balkons, gesjeie door mer 69 centimeters zien de toes vaan ‘e aajd leefdesverhaol.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Veur e paar cent vertèlle get kinder diech ‘t verhaol.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen eiland is populair es daagbestumming of weekendexcursie en beujt kanoë, wandele, winkels, restaurants en mie aon.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Dees authentiek gemeinsjap is te vinde in Howe Sound sjus boete Vancouver, en is gemekelek te berieke via watertaxi deenste dee vertrèkke vaan Granville island in ‘t centrum vaan Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Veur hun wat kinne genete vaan boeteactiviteite, is ‘nen trèk nao de Sa to Sky corridor ‘n must.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 oor rije vaan Vancouver) is deur, des bekint vaan de olympische speule vaan 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: In de winter geneetste vaan ‘t bèste skië in Noord Amerika, en in de zomer kinste authentiek mountainbike perbere.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Vergönninge mote vaan te veure gereserveerd weure. De moos ‘n vergönning höbbe um te euvernachte bij Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena is de einsigste boswachtershut wat slaopplaotse en werm maole aonbeujt neve campeermeugelekhede. La Leona, San pedrille, en Los Patos beeje allein campeerplaotse zoonder bikservice aon.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: ‘t Is meugelek um vergönninge te kriege bij de Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, meh ze acceptere gein credit cards.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: De park deens (MINAE) gief gein vergönninge eder es ein maond veur de verwach aonkoms oet.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol beujt e reserveringsdeens aon veur d’n kos vaan US$30, of $10 veur daagkeerte; details kint g’r vinde op häör pagina.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: De Cook eilande zien ‘ne eilandstaot in Polynesië in los associatie mèt Nui-Zieland, in ‘t midde vaan de Stèllen Oceaan.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: ‘t Is ‘n eilandegróp bstaond oet 15 eilande verspreid euver 2.2 mieljoen km2 oceaon.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Mèt dezelfde tiedzone es Hawaii, staon de eilande bekint es “Hawaii down under”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Allewel kleiner, deit ‘t awwer bezeuker dinke aon ‘t Hawaii vaan veur de groete hotels en aander oontwikkelinge.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: De cook eilande höbbe gein steie meh bestaon oet 15 versjèllende eilande. De balaankriekste zien Rarotonda en Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Allewijl in oontwikkelde lande zien luks bed en breakfasts verweurde tot ‘n soort vaan kuns.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Gans beuvenaon, concurere B&Bs veurnaomelek op twie hoofzake: bedde en dejeuners.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Zoe kint geer beì de fijnste etablisseminte mies luxe bedde en handgemaakde sprije of ‘n antiek bed vinde.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: ‘t Dejeuner zouw sezoensproducte of de chefs speciaoliteite kinne bevatte.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: De setting zouw e aajd, historisch bouw kinne zien met antiek meubels, geregeerd terrein en e zwumbad.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: In dien eige oto stappe en op weeg gaon veur ‘ne lange trip heet ‘n intrinsiek aontrèkkingsforce in zien einvoud.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: in tegenstèeling tot groetere voortuige, zeet g’r al bekint met oto rije en kint g’r de beperkinge devaan.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Campere op privéterrein of in ‘n stad egaoleg wie groet, kin gemeekelek verkierde aodach trèkke.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: In ‘t kot, is t gebruuk vaan uur oto ‘n gooj meneer um ‘n road trip te make meh zelde op ziech ‘n meneer um te campere.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Campere met de oto is meugelek es me e groet böske heet, SUV, persoeneoto of stationwagel boe-vaan de steul neergeklap kinne weure.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Sommege hotels höbbe ‘n erfenis vaan de gouwen tied vaan de stoumtreine en oceaan sjepe; veur d’n twiede wereld oorlog, in de 19de of vreug 20ste iew.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Dees hotels waore boe de rieke en bereumpde van deen tied zouwe verblieve en hadde dèks fien diners en nachleve.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: De awwerwèts inriechting, ‘t gebrek aon de modernste veurzieninge en ‘n bepaald gracieus leeftied heure ouch bij hun karakter.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Terwijl ze privébezit zien, kinne zie soms ouch bezeukend staotshoofde of aander hoegweerdeghede accommodere.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: ‘N reizeger mèt helvers geld zouw n vlöch roond de wereld kinne euverwege oonderbroke door verblieve in väöl vaan dees hotels.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: ‘N hospitaliteids oetwisselingsnètwerk is de organisatie eat reizegers verbint met de lokaal bevolking in de steie wat zie goon bezeuke.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: G’r bij zoe e nètwerk voge is miestal snel gedoon mèt ‘t invulle vaan ‘n online formelier; Dès sommege nètwerke beeje of vraoge beìkoùmend beweìs.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: ‘N lies vaan de desponibel verheurders weurd daan geprint en/of online versjaf, soms mèt referenties en reviews vaan aander reizegers.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfe is gestieg in jannewarie 2004 nao dat computer programmeur Casey Fenton e goojekoup vleegticket nao Iesland had gevoonde mer nörgens kós slaope.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Heer mailde studente vaan de plaotseleke universiteit en kroog ‘n euverweldegend aontal beriechte mèt woènne veur niks.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hostels riechte ziech veunaomelek op jonglui - de doorsnee gaste zien in de twinteg - meh de kins dèks ouch awwer reizegers vinde.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Gezinne mèt kinder zien zeldzaam, dès sommege hotels laote ‘n touw in apaarte kamers.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: De stad Beijing in China zal de gaststad zien vaan de olympische winterspeule in 2022, wat ‘t de ierste stad zal make die zoewel de zomer es de winter speule heet georganiseert.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Peking zal de fièste beì oùpenink en àfsluìte en de binne eveneminte op ies organisere.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Aander ski-eveneminte zalle in ‘t Taizicheng ski gebeed zien in Zhangjiakou, ongeever 220 km (140 mijl) vaan Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: De mieste tempels höbbe e jaorleks fèsitval wat doort vaan eind-november tot midde-mei, wat varrieert vólges eder tempels jaorkalender.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: De mieste vaan de tempels fèstivals weure geviert es oonderdeil vaan de tempels zjubilei, of d’n verjaordaag vaan de residerende godheid of eder aander groet gebäörtenis wat mèt d’n tempel te make heet.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Kerala tempel fèsitvals zien hiel interresant veur te zien, mèt ‘ne regelmaotegen Broonk vaan verseerde olifante, tempel orkeste en aandere fèstiviteite.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: ‘n Wereldexpositie (geweunlijk Wereldexpositie of gewoen Expo geneump) is ‘n groet internationaol fèstival vaan de kunste en de wetensjap.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Deilnummende lande prezentere artistiek en educatieve exposities in natinaole paveljoene um wereldprobleme te exposere of hun lands cultuur en historie.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Internationaole gardeneerexposities zien gespecialiseerde eveneminte wat blomme, botanische häöf en alles wat anders mèt plante te make heet, umvatte.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: In theorie zouwe ze eder jaor plaots kinne vinde (zoe lang es ze en aander lande gehawwe weurde) meh in de praktiek zien ze dat neet.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Dees eveneminte dore gewoenelek, örges tösse de drei en zes maonde en weure gehawwe op locaties neet kleiner es 50 hectare.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: De höbs erg väöl versjèllende fèlm formate wat gebruuk zien euver de jaore. Standaard 35 mm fèlm (36 x 24 mm negatieve) is zeker de gewoenste.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: ‘t Kin gewoenelek gemekelek aongevult weure es ‘t op raak, en giet rizzelutie wat vergeliekbaar is mèt ‘n modern DSLR.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: somege midde-formaat fèlm camera’s gebruuke e 6 x 6 formaat; exacter e 56 x 56 mm negatief.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Dit giet ‘n rizzelutie vaan bienao veer kier groeter es dat vaan ‘n 35 mm negatief (3136 mm2 tegeneuver 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Wièl bèste zeìn ein vaan de lestegste objecte veur ‘ne fotograaf, en de höbs ‘n combinaite vaan gelök, gedöld, ervaring en good materiaal nudeg.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Sjoen natuurfotografie weurd dèks es vaanzelfsprekend besjouwd, meh sjus wie mèt aander foto’s zeet e beeld mie es doezend weurd.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Fottografiè van t wièlt hit  dèks ‘n groete telelens nudeg, ès dinge wie ‘n vlöch veugel of klein bieskes höbbe aandere lense nudeg.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Väöl exotische bieste zien lesteg te vinde, en parke höbbe soms reìgels euver ‘t numme vaan foto’s vaanwege commercieele grun.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Wèl bieste zouwe of sjiechteg, of aggressief kinne zien. De omgeving zouw kaajd, heit, of aanderszins vijandeg kinne zien.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: De wereld heet mie es 5000 versillende taole, inclusief mie es twinteg mèt 50 mieljoen of mie sprekers.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Gesjreve weurd zien dèks gemekeleker te begriepe as gesproke weurd. Dit is zeker woer veur adresse, wat dèks lesteg verstaonbaar oet te spreke zien.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Väöl lande zien gans vloeiend in ‘t Ingels, en in nóg mie kinste get basiskinnes verwachte - veural oonder de jonglui.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Stèl diech veur, este wèls, ‘n Mancuniaan, Bostoniaan, Jamaicaan en Sydneysider wat roontelum ‘n taofel zitte um te dinere in e restaurant in Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ze traktere ziech op verhaole vaan hun thoesstei, vertèld in hun eige versjillende accente en lokaal dialek.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Ete koupe in de supermerret is normaal gesproke de goojkoupste meneer um diech te veuje. Es geine meugelekheid um te koke is zien de keuzes beperk tot kant-en-klaar maole.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Steeds dèkser zuuste bij supermarkte ‘n groetere variatie in kant-en-klaar. Somege höbbe zelfs ‘n magnetron of aander meugelekheid um ete te werme.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: In somege soorte winkels höbste ten minste ein restaurant op ‘t terrein, dèks zeet zoe sjiek mèt betaolbaar prijze.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Maak kopies vaan eur verzekeringspolis en num die mèt same mèt de contact gegevens vaan eur verzekeraar.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ze mote ‘t mailadres vaan de verzekeraar en internationaol tèllefoon nummers laote zien veurdat ze advies geve/claims kinne otorisere.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Zörg veur ‘n extra kopie in eur bagaasj en online (sjik eurzelf ‘n mail mèt bijlage of höb ‘t bestand in de cloud stoon.
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Es g’r mèt ‘n laptop of tablet reis, maak dan ‘n kopie vaan de hel sjijf (touwgaankelek zoonder internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Geef ouch ‘n kopie vaan de polis aon ‘n reiskammeraot en femilie toes die wèlle helpe.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Elande (ouch wel elk geneump) zien neet inherent aggresief, meh ze zalle z’ch verdedige es ze ziech bedreig veule.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Wienie lui elande neet es potentieel gevierlek zien, zouwe ze te koteì kinne koume en loupe ze ‘n risico.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Drink alcohol mèt mate. Acohol heet op ederein ‘n aander effek en dien sjraom kinne is erg belaankriek.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Somege lange termijn effekte vaan excessief drinke kinne leversjade meh zelfs blindheid en de dood zien. ‘t Gevaar weur groeter mèt zelfgestook alcohol.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: illegaol draank kin somege gevaarleke stoffe bevatte zoewie methanol, wat blindheid od de dood kin veroorzake zelfs in kleine doses.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Brèlle kinne goojkouper zien in ‘t boeteland, zeker in e liegeinkomeslande boe arbeid goojkoupe is.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: g’r Zouw thoes ‘n ougmeting kinne laote doen, zeker es de verzekering ‘t dèk, en ‘t rizzeltaot mèt kinne numme nao ‘t boeteland.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Kwaliteit merkmonture in zulke gebede kinne twie probleme höbbe; somege kinne nep zien, an de ecte zien geïmporteerd en woersjijnelek deurder es thoes.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Koffie is ein vaan de werelds mies verhandelde geujere, en de kins waarsjijnelek väöl versjèllende types vinde in dien ege regio.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Desoondaanks, zien ‘rs väöl menere um koffie te drinke roond de wereld wat de meujte zien um te ervare.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (of canyoneering) geit euver ‘t aofdaole nao de boojem vaan ‘n kloof mèt of zoonder water.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning combineert elemente vaan Zwumme klumme en springe - meh behoof eigelek wieneg training of lichameleke fitheid um te kinne beginne (vergeleke mèt klumme, duke of skië beveurbeeld).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Trèkke is ‘n boeteactiviteit wat besteit out wandele in de natuur, miestal op trèkpaajer.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Oonder ‘ne daagtrèk valle aofstande vaan e paar kilometer to langere aofstande wat op ein daag aogelag kinne weure.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Veur ‘ne daagtrèk op e sumpel paad zien neet väöl veurbereidinge nudeg en eder gezoon mins kin daovaan genete.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Femilies mèt klein kinder mote z’ch beter veurbereie, meh ‘n ganse daag boete doorbrenge is zeker meugelek zelfs mèt baby’s en dróbbele.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internationaol zien ‘rs bienoa 200 tour organisaties. De mieste daovaan zien zelfstandeg.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: De veurgaanger vaan de Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours heet e nètwerk vaan tientalle sightrunning providers op veer continente.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Mèt roots in Barcelona’s Running Tours Barcelona en Koupenhages Running Copenhagen, waor ‘t snel verboonde met Running Tours Prague wat in Praag zit.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Veurtot ste öreges naotouw reis zien ‘rs väöl zake boe-euver de mós naodinke.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Es g’r öreges naotouw reis, verwach daan neet tot alles zoe is wie thoes. Menere, regels, ete, verkier, accomodaties en taol enzoeweier kinne allemaol aanders zien es boe g’r vendaon komp.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Dat moot g’r uuch good oonthawwe um teleurstellinge te veurkoume en uuch op te riechte euver de lokaal meneer van doen.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Reisbureaus zien oontstande in de 19de iew. ‘n reisbureau is mietsal ‘n gooje meneer um ‘n reis boete de ervaring vaan de reizeger wat betref natuur, cultuur, taol of lieginkomeslen.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Allewel de mieste bureaus alle bookinge acceptere, zalle väöl bureaus z’ch gespecialiseerd höbbe in ‘n bepaold type reis, budget, of bestumminge.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: ‘t Kin beter zien um ‘n bureau te gebruke wat dèks reize organiseerd wat lieke op eure.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Kiek ‘ns nao wat ‘t reisbureau aon ‘t promote is op hun website of hun etalaasj.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Es g’r de wereld goojkoup wèl zien oet noedzaak, lifestyle of vaanwege de oetdaging daan zien ‘rs menere um dà te doùn.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ze valle in twie catergorië: of de wèrks oonderwijl ‘t reize of de perbeers de koste te limitere. Dit artikel geit euver ‘t lètste.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Veur de lui wat comfort, tied en veurspelbaarheid kinne misse, um de koste zoe lieg meugelek te hawwe, gaank nao budget travel.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: ‘t advies geit daovaan oet dat reizegers neet klawwe, op privé terrein koume, nao illegaol merrete gaon, bedele of on eder aander meneer de lui misbruke veur eige gewin.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Paspoortcontrol is miestal de ierste stop naodat me ‘t vleegtuig, sjip of aander voortuig heet verlaote.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Op somege internationaol treine vind de paspoortcontrole plaots op de rijende trein, en me moot ‘n gèldeg ID kaart bij höbbe op zoe ‘n trein.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Op slaoptreine zouwe de paspoorte door d’n conducteur verzameld kinne weure zoetot g’r neet gewèk hoof te weure.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Registratie is ouch nudeg in ‘t visa proces. in somege len, moot g’r uuch en de verbliefsadresse registrere bij de lokaal euverhede.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Hei veur is ‘t misjiens nudeg op ‘n papìer in te völle beì de polis of moot g’r ‘t immigratiebureau bezeuke.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: In väöl len mèt zulke wètte, kin eur hotel 't eìnschreìve veur uuch doen (vraog ‘t wel iers).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: In aander gevalle, mote allein toeriste boete toeristaccomodaties z’ch laote registrere. Allewel maak dit de wèt e stök mie oonduidelek, zeuk dat dus vaan te veure oet.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arsjitektuur geit euver ‘t oontwerpe en de bouw vaan bouwe. De arsjitektuur vaan ‘n plaots is dèks ‘n toeristische attractie op ziech.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Väöl bouwe zien prachteg um te bekieke en ‘t oetziech vaan ‘ne hoeg bouw op ‘ne slumme plaots kin werkelek fantastisch zien.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arjitektuur heet raakvlakke met aander vakgebede boe-oonder planologie, civiele techniek, decoratieve kunste, interieur oontwerpe en landsjap arsjitektuur.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Este kieks nao wie aofgelege de pueblos zien, zallste neet kinne stappe zoonder zao Albuquerque of Santa Fe te goon.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: allewel, bienoa alle cosino’s hei-bove mage alcohol sjinke, en e paar daovaan höbbe good entertainment (veural de groetere wat direk roond Albuquerque en Santa Fe ligke).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Pas op: klein dörpscafés zien neet altied gooj plèkke veur boelanders um naotouw te goon.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Eine groond is umtot in Noord Nui Mexico väöl probleme zien mèt bezope chauffeurs, en ‘rs väöl vaan hun zien roond dees klein cafés.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Oongewinsde muursjrifte of gekrabbel doà op heit graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Allewijl ‘t absoluut gein modern fenomeen is, associere de mieste lui ‘t mèt jäögvandalisme vaan de publieke ruimte en privéhöb met spuitbösse.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: allewiel, tegeweurdeg, zien ‘rs gevesteg kunsteneers, graffiti eveneminte en legaol moere. Graffiti op dees plaotse liekent mie op kunst es illegaol, oonaontrèkkelek sjrif.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Boemarang goeje is ‘n populair sport wat väöl toeriste wèlle liere.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Este wèls liere wie de ‘ne boemerang mos goeje wat trögk kump nao d’n hand, móste zeker wete tot d’n boemerang gesjik is.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: De mieste boemerangs watste krijgs in Australië koume eigelek neet trögk. ‘t Is veur beginners ‘t bèste um neet in winderege umstandeghede te gooje.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: ‘n Hangi maol is gekook in ‘n heite kojl.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: De kojl weurd verhits mèt heite stein vaan e vörke, of op plaoste boe geothermiek de groond verhits op ‘n natuurleke meneer.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: De hangi weurt dèks gebruuk um ‘n traditioneìl ruuster diner te bereie.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Versjèllende plaotse in Rotorua höbbe geothermische Hangi, dès aandere Hangi kinne gepreuf weure in Christchurch, wellington en ‘n aander.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail heet twie klasse op forenzetreine in en roond Kaapstad: MetroPlus (ierste klas) en Metro (derde klas).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus beujt väöl mie comfort en is neet zoe drök mer is ouch deurder, meh nog altied goojkouper es metrotickets in Europa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Ederen trein heet zoewel MetroPlus en Metro rijtuige; de achterste rijtuige zien altied vaan MetroPlus, ‘t kortste bij Kaapstad.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Drage veur andere - verluus noets eur koffers oet ‘t oug, zeker neet wienie g’r euver internationaol sjaome gaot.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: g’r Zouw misbruuk kinne weure es drugskoeries zoonder dat g’r t weit, wat veur veul probleme zouw kinne zörge.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Dat beteikent ouch in de rij staon, want drugshun zouwe zoonder waarsjouwing gebruuk kinne weure.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Somege len höbbe draconische straffe veur zelfs es ‘t de ierste euvertrejjing is; dat beteikent dat gevaangenisstraove vaan mie es 10 jaor of de doedsstraof opgelag kinne weure.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.
